B.site_order: x, y, z; z fastest; spin fastest within site
B.translation_convention: T_i sends a site basis ket to the next periodic site
B.spectral_root: Hermitian eigendecomposition of A-dagger A; no entrywise roots or negative-eigenvalue clipping
B.linear_solves: scipy.linalg.solve(assume_a=her) for polar factor; solve_sylvester for K
